sn56.39:1.1: ye hi keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:1.2: “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti. te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:1.3: “ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī”ti.
sn56.39:2.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, tūlapicu vā kappāsapicu vā lahuko vātūpādāno same bhūmibhāge nikkhitto.
sn56.39:2.2: tamenaṃ puratthimo vāto pacchimena saṃhareyya, pacchimo vāto puratthimena saṃhareyya, uttaro vāto dakkhiṇena saṃhareyya, dakkhiṇo vāto uttarena saṃhareyya.
sn56.39:2.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:2.6: “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti. te aññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:2.7: “ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī”ti.
sn56.39:3.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave, samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:3.2: “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, te nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:3.3: “ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī”ti.
sn56.39:4.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ayokhīlo vā indakhīlo vā gambhīranemo sunikhāto acalo asampakampī.
sn56.39:4.2: puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya. pacchimāya cepi disāya …pe… uttarāya cepi disāya …pe… dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi, neva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampacāleyya.
sn56.39:4.5: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye hi keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā “idaṃ dukkha”nti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe…
sn56.39:4.6: “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti, te nāññassa samaṇassa vā brāhmaṇassa vā mukhaṃ olokenti
sn56.39:4.7: “ayaṃ nūna bhavaṃ jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passatī”ti.
sn56.39:5.1: tasmātiha bhikkhave, “idaṃ dukkha”nti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… “ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā”ti yogo karaṇīyoti.
